description: MCP server for Claude Desktop and Claude Code. Keeps a project's facts (stack, goal, commands) in project.faf, an IANA-registered YAML file (application/vnd.faf+yaml), with tools to create, score and fill it, write CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md from it, and keep project memory in soul.fafm.
rules: Call faf_init to create project.faf for a folder, then faf_score to see which slots are empty; faf_go suggests the goal and six W's for the user to confirm.
Treat project.faf as the source of the project's facts; faf_sync writes CLAUDE.md from it and faf_tri_sync writes faf's block into the MEMORY.md Claude Code loads.
A core set of tools is listed by default; set FAF_TOOLS=all to list the rest. Every tool is callable by name either way.
